name: JoAi: Set Automation Actions

description.en: Replace the ordered action list (wait, send_email, halt) for an automation. Blocked while enrollments are active. At most one send_email in v1.
description.de: Ersetzt die Aktionsliste (wait, send_email, halt). Blockiert, solange Enrollments aktiv sind. Maximal eine send_email in v1.
description.fr: Remplace la liste ordonnée d'actions (wait, send_email, halt). Bloqué tant que des enrollments sont actifs. Au plus un send_email en v1.
description.es: Sustituye la lista ordenada de acciones (wait, send_email, halt). Bloqueado mientras haya enrollments activos. Como máximo un send_email en v1.
description.it: Sostituisce l'elenco ordinato di azioni (wait, send_email, halt). Bloccato con enrollment attivi. Al massimo un send_email in v1.
description.ro: Înlocuiește lista ordonată de acțiuni (wait, send_email, halt). Blocat cât timp există enrollment-uri active. Cel mult un send_email în v1.

bot: Pass automationId and actions JSON array in order. Example: wait → send_email → halt. Fails if any enrollment is still active.

inputs.name: Actions
inputs.bot: Ordered JSON: [{"type":"wait","config":{"delayMinutes":60}},{"type":"send_email","config":{"sendMode":"direct","subject":"…","body":"…"}},{"type":"halt","config":{}}]. Or track via campaign: {"type":"send_email","config":{"sendMode":"campaign","campaignId":"…"}}.

error.fr: Échec de la définition des actions : {{MESSAGE}}
error.es: No se pudieron definir las acciones: {{MESSAGE}}
